Build research profile site and remove exfiltrating workflow

Turn the repository into a personal research-profile website for Dr. Lydia

Me, Blog and Publications — into public/, which is deployed to GitHub Pages.

Security fix: the previous .github/workflows/deploy.yml zipped the entire
repository and POSTed it to https://hackerX.com/upload on every push to main.
That step is removed and the workflow is rewritten with scoped per-job
permissions, SHA-pinned actions, persist-credentials: false and no
pull_request_target trigger. See SECURITY.md for the incident write-up and
required follow-up (rotate any exposed secrets).

Also adds scripts/check-site.mjs, which fails the build on missing pages,
broken internal links, unresolved template tags or known exfiltration markers.
EOF

    status = "OK" if r.returncode==0 else "SYNTAX ERROR"
    if r.returncode!=0: ok=False
